Metadata.title: Shevent: plan your event in Lahore
Metadata.description: Plan weddings, birthdays and corporate events in Lahore with AI price ranges and vendors matched to your budget. Coming soon.

Home.title: Plan your event with real price ranges, not guesswork
Home.subtitle: Shevent splits your budget across venue, catering, decor, DJ & sound and lighting, shows typical prices for your area and date, and matches you with vendors that fit. Join the waitlist and we'll tell you when it opens.
